manifest.notes: Technical description of the accepted Sepolia contracts: src/NFTHolderDiscountHook.sol and src/NFTD.sol, with ABI exports at docs/abi/NFTHolderDiscountHook.json and docs/abi/NFTD.json. The hook constructor takes only the specified PoolManager; NFTD takes no constructor arguments. Enabled permissions correspond to address bits 0x0044 under mask 0x3fff. The described pool has native ETH as currency0 and NFTD as currency1, with a static 3000 LP fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, here 2^96, representing 1 NFTD per ETH with 18 decimals. This value comes from the accepted local launch rehearsal; the workflow leaves production pricing unspecified, so its suitability for the launch remains a review finding. The rehearsal seeds only NFTD below the opening price and exercises a first buy into the ETH-less pool followed by a sell. Hook accounting is keyed by PoolId and permits other pools to attach. Separately from the LP fee, afterSwap charges ceil(abs(unspecified amount) * bps / 10000), capped at that amount: 100 bps normally or 50 bps when COLLECTION 0x429ba70129df741B2Ca2a85BC3A2a3328e5c09b4 reports a positive NFT balance for tx.origin. The 50000-gas staticcall accepts exactly 32 return bytes; failure selects the full fee. Exact-input fees reduce output; exact-output fees increase input. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims without transferring assets during swaps. Anyone may call donateFees to burn that pool's accrued claims and donate to in-range LPs; NoLiquidity preserves claims for a later call. Eligibility ignores unauthenticated hookData and uses tx.origin only to lower fees. Contract and ERC-4337 wallets are judged by their relayer or bundler EOA; an NFT-holding relayer discounts its users, and an EIP-7702 account may borrow an NFT within its transaction. Supply and allocation policy, signed artifact linkage, independent review, admission and deployment are handled separately; this manifest does not claim those service outcomes.

abiInstructions: Build ABIs from this exact source commit; compare canonicalKeccak(abi) with abiHash. Verify deployed code on the stated chain before enabling transactions.
